reasons.plausibility: It aligns well with established principles of entropy-driven stabilization and the known role of local ordering in high-entropy alloys.
reasons.testability: They propose a clear compositional change followed by direct in situ measurements, which would unambiguously confirm or refute the impact of pair interactions on short-range order.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses how to control and verify structural and chemical stability in high-entropy nanoalloys at elevated temperatures, offering practical experimental guidance.
